title: The Cairn Stones
text: A cairn of stones over a grave by the road, waist high, every stone a different colour. Each traveller adds one, the custom goes, so the dead know they are remembered. The cairn has been growing for a long time. Whoever lies under it is very well remembered.

options.label: Each of you adds a stone for the dead.

outcomes.text: The cairn grows, and the barrows around you seem to settle, quieter.

options.label: Take a stone instead, for luck.

outcomes.text: Bad luck. It is heavier than it should be, and it follows you home.

options.label: The strongest digs under the cairn.

outcomes.text: A warrior's grave goods, wrapped in rotten cloth.
The warrior, and he did not want to be remembered this way.
